# Sakshi Pradip Papad
> Authentic Gujarati Papad Manufacturer & Supplier | Rajkot & Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India

## Overview
Sakshi Pradip Papad is an authentic Indian culinary brand specialising in traditional, hand-rolled, sun-dried Gujarati papads. Formulated using pure moong dal, premium udad dal, whole spices (black pepper, cumin, hing / asafoetida), and zero artificial preservatives. Products are packed in moisture-lock food-grade packs for retail households and wholesale caterers, shops, and banquet suppliers across Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, and pan-India.

## Product Portfolio
1. **Moong Mari Papad (મગ મરી પાપડ / मूंग काली मिर्च पापड़)**
   - Ingredients: Pure Moong Dal, Black Pepper (Mari), Asafoetida, Rock Salt, Edible Oil.
   - Profile: Crisp, mild spiced with pungent black pepper aroma. Best roasted or air-fried.
   - Pack Sizes: 200g, 500g, 1kg, 5kg bulk box.

2. **Udad Jeera Papad (અડદ જીરું પાપડ / उड़द जीरा पापड़)**
   - Ingredients: Premium Udad Dal, Roasted Cumin Seeds (Jeera), Papadhkar, Salt, Spices.
   - Profile: Golden crispy blisters, digestive cumin warmth. Ideal for Gujarati thali & snacks.
   - Pack Sizes: 200g, 500g, 1kg, 5kg bulk box.

3. **Lasaniya Papad (Garlic & Chilli) (લસણીયા પાપડ / लसणिया पापड़)**
   - Ingredients: Moong & Udad Dal, Desi Garlic Paste, Red Chilli Powder, Asafoetida, Salt.
   - Profile: Bold, garlicky, spicy kick for masala papad and evening snacks.
   - Pack Sizes: 200g, 500g, 1kg, 5kg bulk box.

4. **Sindhi Masala Papad (મસાલા પાપડ / सिंधी मसाला पापड़)**
   - Ingredients: Udad Dal, Crushed Black Pepper, Coriander Seeds, Ajwain, Red Chilli, Salt.
   - Profile: Robust spice kick, restaurant-style masala papad base.
   - Pack Sizes: 200g, 500g, 1kg.

5. **Traditional Rice Khichiya (ખીચિયા પાપડ / चावल का खीचिया)**
   - Ingredients: Steamed Rice Flour (Chawal Atta), Cumin, Sesame Seeds, Salt, Papad Khar.
   - Profile: Ultra-light, airy crunch, melt-in-the-mouth authentic Gujarati specialty.
   - Pack Sizes: 250g, 500g, 1kg.

## Geographical Coverage & Supply Chain
- **Primary Hubs**: Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Jamnagar, Bhavnagar (Gujarat).
- **Secondary Hubs**: Mumbai, Pune, Delhi NCR, Jaipur, Indore, Bangalore (Pan-India courier & freight).
- **Fulfillment**: Retail packs (courier/speed post) & Wholesale 5kg/10kg bulk corrugated cartons.
